verdict.rationale: Docusign's core e-signature, template, and workflow features (docusign-docs-1, docusign-docs-6, docusign-docs-7, docusign-docs-4) are generic enough to send and sign any document type, including offer letters or agreements, but no evidence specifically addresses HR/equity workflows like option grants, cap-table integration, or IP/confidentiality agreement templates. Missing for 10: HR-specific template library, equity/option-grant workflow examples, integration with cap-table or HRIS systems, and any legal-ops case study demonstrating this exact use case.
